en.description: Balaton100 Supermarathon is a ultramarathon. Location: Balatonfüred, Hungary. Date: 13 March 2027 – 14 March 2027. Distances: 100 km, 2Etappen. Entry fee: check with the organiser. The map below shows the host town; check the organiser for the exact start line.
